scope: 408 training roots; ranking diagnostics are in-sample and are not battle win rates. Independent fixed development screen remains separate; final test sealed.

protocol.hypothesis: Per-root highest available terminal-policy tier can improve win/loss ranking without adding manual card values.
protocol.evaluation: Both full and linear; unchanged 15 development cases, first 5 screen, stop on any material regression or unverified outcome. Final test sealed.
protocol.diagnostics: Audit all original preferences, including tiers excluded from fitting. Training diagnostics are not validation.
protocol.defaultCompatibility: First 20 ordered roots; frozen v39 vs current all default, both outputs must be byte identical.

costNotes: cost includes compatibility and experimental fits, candidate development searches and new-model audits; originalDiagnosticSeconds separately records the two concurrent initial audits. Prior collection/training costs remain in v39/overnight lineage and are not reset.
